messages:
sara: Kicking off a config-only deploy now for routing + batching tweaks. Target window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Deploybot command: `/deploy start config-only routing-batch-2026-03-22 --stagger 10m --cohorts 3`

deploy-bot: ✅ Started deploy `routing-batch-2026-03-22`
- mode: config-only
- cohorts: 3 (10m stagger)
- change-window: 02:00-03:00 UTC
- owner: sara

brad: quick ask — what's the rollback trigger? latency p99 + kv_cache_pressure? :thinking_face:

lina: suggested triggers in release notes: p99 > baseline + 40ms for 5m OR kv_cache_pressure > 0.7 for 3m. Also prefer per-tenant pin to earlier model if we see errors.

owen: adding: cost-per-token regen shouldn't jump more than 5% else rollback. Can we pin heavy tenants to old routing at start?

sara: yes, plan is cohort 1 = 10% traffic (non-enterprise tenants), cohort 2 = 40%, cohort 3 = 50% with enterprise excluded from cohort 3 initially. Pin list lives in the deploy playbook.

maria: I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards. Dashboard links: https://console.redwood/obs/routing-batch-2026-03-22 and the alerts are on-call SLO channel.

brad: pls post the exact config diff here for quick eyeballs.

sara: config snippet: ```yaml
routing_policy:
  default_weight: 1.0
  model_overrides:
    - tenant_group: small
      weight: 0.9
    - tenant_group: large
      weight: 0.7
batching:
  max_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_size: 48
  tail_latency_ms: 40
limits:
  inflight_per_tenant: 12
  timeout_ms: 12000
```

lina: LGTM, only comment: reduce inflight_per_tenant to 8 for cohort 1 to be extra safe.

sara: updated and re-applied for cohort 1. deploy-bot, apply small-cohort override.

deploy-bot: applying override to cohort 1: `inflight_per_tenant: 8` — started at 02:00:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: cohort 1 completed (10% traffic). Observability: latency p50/p95 stable, p99 +12ms, kv_cache_pressure 0.32, errors 0.05% — continuing to cohort 2 in 10m.

sara: @maria please watch model fallback counts and any 5xx spikes.

maria: watching. set an alert for model_fallback_rate > 0.5% (5m). I'll escalate if we hit it.

deploy-bot: cohort 2 started at 02:12:30 UTC (ramped to 40%).

brad: seeing a slight p99 uptick on a subset of geo requests — northeast region. Could be kv cache warmup. What's the plan?

sara: hold on cohort 3 if p99 > baseline + 40ms for 5m. Also we can pin /route northeast to prior model variant for affected tenants. Lina, can you stage that pin?

lina: will stage a geo pin for northeast tenants: `/deploy edit-pin --region us-east-2 --variant stable-v2026-02` — queued, will only activate if we hit threshold.

deploy-bot: alert: geo_p99_northeast = baseline + 46ms for 6m. Holding cohort 3.

owen: good call to hold. Recommend running a targeted small warmup on kv cache for that region: `kv-cache warmup --region us-east-2 --range sample-tenants`

maria: warmup started. monitoring shows kv_cache_pressure dropping and p99 trending down.

sara: after 12m of observation, p99 back to baseline + 10ms and fallback counts normal. Proceeding to cohort 3 at 02:36 UTC.

deploy-bot: cohort 3 started at 02:36:10 UTC (ramped to 50%).

deploy-bot: deploy complete — routing-batch-2026-03-22 rolled out to all cohorts. Final metrics: p99 +18ms, kv_cache_pressure 0.29, error-rate 0.07%, cost-per-token +2.1%. No rollbacks executed. :tada:

brad: nice. action items: 1) add geo warmup to playbook, 2) add inflight_per_tenant recommendation per cohort, 3) update release notes with final metrics.

sara: creating release note now: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/routing-batch-2026-03-22. Notes include config diff, cohort plan, rollback criteria, and owners.

lina: closing loop — I'll open a tiny follow-up canary for northeast next week with the warmup baked in.

maria: postmortem not needed since no incidents, but I'll archive the alert snapshots in the runbook.

sara: thanks team. If anyone sees regressions outside business hours, ping #oncall and me directly.

owen: kudos. :shipit:
